meta.title: Hawks Coaching Game Prep
meta.subtitle: Current Hawks archetypes versus selected Eastern playoff-relevant opponents
meta.method_note: This demo combines DelQuant current-player archetypes, public-safe competitive trait outputs, and opponent split summaries. It is a coaching scout prompt, not a replacement for film, practice context, or proprietary team data.
meta.ip_note: Only precomputed outputs are exposed. The model internals, formulas, scoring weights, and training logic are intentionally withheld.

framework.archetypes: 54 functional player archetypes used to describe what role a player performs.
framework.archetype_usage: The point is not the label itself. The label is a shortcut for the player's functional job: creation, spacing, rim pressure, rebounding, connector passing, defensive activity, or blend role.
framework.championship_dna: Historical outcome research that studies which archetype shapes translate into playoff series wins.

hbb.motor: Heart proxy for activity, availability, rebounding, and defensive event pressure.
hbb.decision: Brains proxy for creation, efficiency, and mistake-control signals.
hbb.pressure: Balls proxy for scoring responsibility and high-leverage shot burden.

framework.game_prep: For each opponent, DelQuant asks how a player's role has traveled: scoring, playmaking, motor, and shooting deltas are shrunk toward baseline based on sample strength.
framework.per36_note: Per-36 is included for low-minute and bench players as role-shape translation only. It is not a playing-time projection.
